About Fidelity International
Fidelity International offers world class investment solutions and retirement expertise. As a privately owned, independent company, investment is our only business. We are driven by the needs of our clients, not by shareholders. Our vision is to deliver innovative client solutions for a better future.
Our people are passionate, engaged, smart and curious, and we give them the independence and the confidence to make a difference. While we take pride in the excellence of our investment solutions and client service, we know we can always do better. We are honest, respectful and make tough calls, challenging the status quo to achieve better outcomes through innovation. Above all else, we always put our clients first.
About Fidelity Dalian
Established in 2007, FIL Technology (Dalian) Limited was the Fidelity’s first wholly owned enterprise in China. The Dalian office initially served as a systems development centre to bolster Fidelity’s growing business in the Asia Pacific region, with a primary focus on providing technology and web-based support and services. The office has continued to expand in recent years and now acts as the central service hub for the Asia Pacific region supporting multiple business functions including systems development and support, systems infrastructure support, retail operations, finance accounting services and investment administration & fund accounting.

Asset Management CAO
team
is responsible front to back, for the operational and supporting capabilities across investment management.
The Investment Management Solutions team
is a cross asset delivery & support function driving collaboration, consistency & execution across the global asset management platform. The team drives strategic initiatives, provide support services enabling our investment team, and partners with our investment leaders to strengthen oversight, risk controls & regional regulatory engagement. Within the IM Solutions function the
Sustainable Investing Solutions team
is responsible for supporting global FIL’s proxy voting activities as well as core governance & reporting activates underpinning FIL’s sustainable investment approach.
About Your Role
As the
SI Solutions - Analyst
, you will play a key role in supporting the firm’s stewardship activities. Your responsibilities will include analyzing shareholder meeting agendas, providing insightful voting recommendations, and executing high‑quality, timely proxy votes in alignment with the firm’s policies and fiduciary duties. You will also contribute to policy development and ongoing process improvements. In this role, you will collaborate closely with investment teams, Sustainable Investing analysts, and proxy service providers to strengthen the firm’s governance framework and enhance our stewardship outcomes.

The successful candidate will be a detail‑oriented governance professional with demonstrated expertise in applying in‑house voting policies and conducting precise research on investee AGM/EGM agendas. This role requires performing accurate analysis in complex or non‑standard voting scenarios and consistently delivering timely, high‑quality voting instructions. With a growing understanding of Sustainable Investing functions, the candidate is expected to operate with strong process discipline, overseeing end‑to‑end vote execution, quality assurance, and pipeline management. As the global regulations related to Sustainable Investing continue to evolve rapidly, the candidate must be able to learn, adapt, and refine deliverables to meet emerging requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Review and analyze FIL Investee companies’ global shareholder meeting agendas, focusing on complex corporate governance, remuneration, and ESG related proposals.
Conduct researches and FIL voting policy application by leveraging FIL’s research capabilities, in-house voting policy, and external research resources to make thorough and informed voting recommendations for Sustainability Investment Analysts and Investment management team.
Assist Sustainability Investment Analysts and Investment management team in engagement activities with investee companies on governance and sustainability topics.
Handle end-to-end vote execution processes to ensure accuracy, timeliness, and compliance. Provide non-standard voting support to address specific client requirements.
Coordinate with external proxy advisors, custodians, and voting platforms to enhance accuracy and efficiency.
Contribute to periodic reviews and updates of proxy voting policies and procedures. Monitor regulatory and market developments in governance, stewardship, and ESG.
Support the preparation of stewardship reports, respond to client inquiries, and complete regulatory disclosures.
Support the implementation of new voting strategies and practices, and identify, drive and contribute to continuous process improvementation.
Develop & maintain consolidated, auditable process documentation library.
Experience And Qualifications Required
Education in Finance, Business, Economics, Sustainability Investment or related field. Master degree is preferred.
Experience in researches and analysis in proxy voting, corporate governance, stewardship, ESG or Sustainable Investing is a strong plus.
Strong analytical and research skills with the ability to interpret corporate filings and governance documents.
Analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and excellent attention to detail and accuracy in a high volume, deadline driven environment.
Data analytical and automation skills (Python/SQL/PowerBI), experience of developing automation for business processes is highly preferred. Experience as Project Manager, Business Analyst, SME is a strong plus.
Proficient in using AI tools to improve efficiency, ensure accuracy, and solve business problems.
Highly efficient English communication skills, both written and verbal is mandatory.
Demonstrated learning ability and interest in Investment knowledge. CFA, FRM related certificate is highly preferred.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, and highly developed teamwork skills
Global stakeholder management and global collaboration model experience is required. Proven record to manage stakeholder and deliver high quality work under pressure.
A good team player with open-minded, flexible and positive attitude for changes.
Self-disciplined and self-motivated to drive business result with a clear career plan.
Feel rewarded
For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

The Opportunity
The CTO team is seeking a visionary, hands-on engineering leader to design, build, and scale HSBC Agent Platform as a core capability within the Group AI Platform. This role will deliver secure, reusable and high-performance platform services that enables team across the bank to build, deploy and operate agentic and generative AI solutions consistently, overing orchestration, tool integration, memory, evaluation and governance-by-design. You’ll set the technical direction, drive reliability and adoption at scale and ensure the platform meets enterprise standard for performance, resilience, security and controls.
What You’ll Do
Define the long-term technical vision and roadmap for the Agent platform in collaboration with product management team
Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of a robust, scalable, and high-performance Agent platform
Stay at the cutting edge of AI and agent movement in the industry, and adapt the agent platform to leverage the technical evolving in the industry
Work closely with technology teams across business lines to understand their requirements and ensure the platform empowers them to build agents efficiently
Integrate agent platform as part of the Group AI Platform which spans on-premise and cloud-based infrastructure
Build and manage a high-performing global team of ML SMEs and full stack engineers, to ensure the AI capabilities are built fit for purpose with high quality
Establish engineering best practices, including continuous integration / continuous delivery pipeline workflows, automation testing framework, and monitoring systems for AI applications, and ensure continuous improvement of engineering practices
Implement observability, reliability, and performance optimizations for agent platform in production
Ensure compliance to architecture principle, technical standards, security requirements and software development life cycle controls
Qualifications
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related subject area
15+ of experience in developing and implementing software solutions, with 5+ years in technical leadership roles.
Hands-on experience in design and development of agentic AI solutions
Proven and deep experience in designing, building, and delivering a large-scale Agent platform
Deep understanding of the agent paradigm, including agent planning, short-term and long-term memory, tool use, agent orchestration and agent evaluation
Experience with high code and low code agent platform
Strong experience in designing and building scalable and resilient platform
Proven ability in building and managing high performing teams of AI SME and full stack engineers
Solid hands-on development skills in programming language such as Java, Python, and CI/CD tools, automation testing, and observability
Proficiency in effective stakeholder management, and capable of effectively articulating AI capabilities, and influencing both business and technology leaders
Experience working in Agile development teams with excellent collaboration skills

Full Time

Key Responsibilities
Join a high-performance team building ultra-low latency trading systems where nanoseconds matter. You’ll design and implement a trading rules engine for real-time controls using a hybrid of FPGA hardware and high-performance C++, enabling deterministic execution and rapid interaction with the markets.
Design and implement real-time trading rules and risk checks using FPGA (Verilog/VHDL) or C++.
Architect cycle-accurate FPGA designs and high-speed network interfaces (10/25/40/100GbE, RoCEv2) is preferred.
Build simulation and verification frameworks for FPGA reliability.
Drive full FPGA design flow (synthesis, place & route, timing closure).
Interface C++ applications with FPGA hardware for real-time orchestration.
Implement lock-free data structures and concurrency control in Linux.
Build low-latency network apps using kernel bypass (e.g., Rivermax).
Analyze system performance and resolve latency bottlenecks.
Collaborate with global IT, Quants, and Traders across asset classes.
Provide Level 3 support for production systems.
The team
You’ll be part of the Algorithmic Trading Team based out of Shanghai within the Execution Services, delivering latency-sensitive infrastructure for Algorithmic Execution, Smart Order Routing, Internalization, and Real-time Controls across global markets.
Your Skills And Experience
7+ years in FPGA (Verilog/VHDL) or low-latency C++ development.
Expert in C++17/20/23, Linux system programming, concurrency.
Deep knowledge of FPGA toolchains (Vivado, Quartus), timing closure.
